stories.title: Teen ‘intentionally' jumped from school building in Highland Park, coroner says
stories.summary: The 17-year-old high school student who died after going over a fourth-floor balcony on his school’s campus in Highland Park “intentionally jumped,” the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner’s Office announced Tuesday. A report released Tuesday said Xavier Nungarary -Martinez died
